feeds.title: Yobob Games Blog
feeds.description: The 'yo' just means hi and the 'bob' is just a generic random name which mostly means to me, anonymous. When you play a video game, there's almost always an option to input your character's name. Every time I play a game with lots of people, the names are usually taken. So I created Yobob, having the idea of joining a server full of people with the intention of being a friendly nobody. Yo-Bob Hey anonymous. I think it's fitting since everyone online is a stranger.
